MORRIS C. KLOWAK Passed away peacefully at Victoria Hospital on Sunday, May 10, 2015, after a short illness. Morris was born September 22, 1930 in Poplarfield, MB. He was predeceased by his beloved wife Edna in 2003, parents Andrew and Maria, sister Olga, brothers William, Peter and Walter, sister-in-law Reta Sillers, brother-in-law Stan Stewart. Morris is survived by stepdaughters Donna Kuzbel, St. Catharines, ON and Marlene Firth, Thunder Bay, ON; granddaughters Vicky Rogers, Magnolia, TX and Valerie Kuzbel, Spring, TX; sister Sandra Rychlicki and husband Mike; and numerous nieces and nephews. Morris found employment with the CN Engineering Department in 1952, based in Thunder Bay, ON, until 1972. He transferred to Winnipeg in 1972 where he held several positions until 1986, taking an early retirement. He retired to Calgary, AB until 2005. He was a United Church member for many years. Cremation has taken place; Glen Lawn Memorial in charge of arrangements. As per his request, no memorial service will be held. Donations in Morris' memory may be made to a charity of choice.

As published in Winnipeg Free Press on May 16, 2015
